title: A leaf and salt, but claims of three dishes
odia:
କାଖରେ ପତର, ହାତରେ ଲୁଣ
ମିଛରେ ବୋଲଇ ତିନି ତିଅଣ।
literal_meaning: A leaf under the arm, salt in the hand—yet falsely claiming three dishes.
meaning_odia: ହାତରେ ଯାହା ଅଛି ତାହା ସାମାନ୍ୟ, କିନ୍ତୁ କହିବା ବେଳେ ବହୁତ କିଛି ଅଛି ବୋଲି ମିଛ ଦାବି କରିବା। ପତର ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହ ତିନି ତିଅଣର କଥାକୁ ମିଳାଇ ବାସ୍ତବ ସମ୍ବଳ ଓ ବଡ଼ କଥାର ଫରକ ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The first line lists what can actually be seen: a leaf and salt. The second announces a much richer meal and explicitly calls that announcement false. The editorial reading is of someone overstating what they have or can offer.
usage_example: Someone advertises a fully equipped workshop, though only a few basic tools are available. A visitor recalls the saying to contrast the claim with the actual provision. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The leaf and salt make a sparse food image; three cooked dishes suggest something more substantial. The word ମିଛରେ makes the criticism explicit, so the contrast turns on false boasting rather than on having little.

odia_summary: ସାମାନ୍ୟ ସମ୍ବଳ ଥାଇ ବି ବହୁତ କିଛି ଅଛି ବୋଲି ମିଛ ଦାବି।
english_summary: A meagre provision is dressed up as a generous offering.
